Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished transparent 2D side-scrolling anime game sprite atlas, Raiden Shogun locomotion. Reference 1 is canonical identity, costume and sword reference; reference 2 is old game art for outfit only. Improve to refined polished adult anime figure, NOT chibi. One consistent woman: long dark violet braid, small gold/purple flower hair ornament, pale lavender kimono top, purple patterned split skirt/tails, red obi knot, dark thigh-high stockings, heeled shoes. Same elegant slim purple glowing single-edged katana with gold guard every frame, no polearm. Full body in every frame, facing screen RIGHT in 3/4 side view. Actual transparent alpha background.
Deliver precisely FOUR columns and THREE rows, twelve equal square cells, high resolution 1536x1152 or larger landscape 4:3. No grid lines, no labels, no captions, no floor or contact shadows. Each figure completely INSIDE its own cell including hair, toes, sword tip and sleeves, at least 24 pixels of empty gutter on ALL sides. Anatomy height consistent within every frame, about 235px if cells384px. Clear crisp game silhouettes, clean anti-aliased alpha, restrained small sword glow.
Row1=4 subtly distinct standing idle breathing frames, blade lowered diagonally right, breathing chest and braid sway, exhale/inhale/peak/settle.
Rows2 and3 form ONE consecutive eight-frame running loop RIGHT, read left-to-right then next row: right-foot contact, compression, push-off, flight, left-foot contact, compression, push-off, flight. Legs MUST alternate clearly, planted foot takes weight, knees articulate, torso leans forward slightly, braid and cloth trail left. Running happens in place in each cell. Sword held safely low to right, balanced motion. No duplicated static poses. Keep head size and body proportions exactly consistent throughout. Strong character recognition and clear thin sword silhouette for downscaling to112px game size.

Edit the supplied Raiden twelve-frame 4x3 sprite sheet. Preserve every pose, anatomy, costume, color and frame order EXACTLY. Main repair ONLY: each entire frame figure including all long sword tips and trailing braid must be about 72% of its current size, centered within its own cell on transparent alpha. Restore any cut-off sword tips/toes/cloth. Leave wide completely empty gutters on all four sides of every cell, no overlap with any neighbor, no content on outer image border. Keep 4 columns3 rows and exactly12 figures. Keep transparent alpha, do not add background or grid lines.
